description: Opaque burgundy-plum floor-length gown with a low square neckline, fitted structured bodice, elbow-length sleeves and gold patterned edging on the neckline, shoulder straps, cuffs, hem and front skirt edges. A broad cream-gold woven panel runs down the center of the bodice and skirt. Round gold shoulder clasps and a narrow decorated waist belt with round center clasp provide ornament. A matching burgundy wrap with broad cream-gold floral borders rests around the forearms and falls along the sides. Small gold dangling earrings and a closed gold-patterned shoe are visible. No armor, headgear or weapon is present.
